Abrabɔ a ɛsɔ Nyankopɔn ani
1Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, anuanom, yɛsrɛ mo na yɛtu mo fo Awurade Yesu mu sɛ, deɛ moanya no yɛn nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mobɔ mo bra na mosɔ Nyankopɔn ani no, saa ara na monkɔ so mma no mmoro soɔ. 2Na monim ahyɛdeɛ a yɛnam Awurade Yesu so de maa mo no. 3Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mo ahoteɛ. Monyi mo ho mfiri adwamammɔ mu, 4#1 Ko 6.13; 6.15 sɛ mo mu biara nhunu sɛdeɛ ɔbɛnya ɔno ara ne yere ahoteɛ ne anidie mu, 5ɛnyɛ akɔnnɔ anibereɛ mu sɛ amanaman mufoɔ a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn no; 6sɛ obiara nntra nnkɔsisi ne nua asɛm bi mu, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ne yeinom nyinaa mu weretɔfoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛka kyerɛɛ mo kane, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ no. 7Na Onyankopɔn amfrɛ yɛn ankɔ efi mu, na mmom ahoteɛ mu. 8#Luk 10.16 Enti deɛ ɔte atua no nte onipa bi so atua, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔde ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ mo mu no.
9 # Yoh 13.34; Yer 31.33-34 Na onuadɔ ho deɛ, ɛnhia mo sɛ wɔtwerɛ brɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo ara na Onyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ mo sɛ monnodɔ mo ho; 10na moyɛ saa nso anuanom a wɔwɔ Makedonia nyinaa ho. Nanso, anuanom, yɛtu mo fo sɛ monkɔ so nyɛ mmoro so, 11#Efe 4.28; 2 Te 3.8; 3.12 na mommɔ mmɔden nyɛ komm, na monyɛ mo ara mo adeɛ, na momfa mo ara mo nsa nyɛ adwuma, sɛdeɛ yɛhyɛɛ mo no, 12#Kol 4.5 na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛfata, wɔn a wɔwɔ akyire no anim, na biribiara anhia mo.
Awurade ba
13 # 1 Ko 15.20; Efe 2.12 Na, anuanom, wɔn a wɔadeda no ho deɛ, yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛsi mo soɔ, na mo werɛ anho sɛ wɔn a aka a wɔnni anidasoɔ no. 14#Rom 14.9; 1 Ko 15.3-4; 15.12 Na sɛ yɛgye di sɛ Yesu wui na wasɔre bio a, saa ara nso na Onyankopɔn de wɔn a wɔadeda no nam Yesu so bɛka ne ho aba. 15#1 Ko 15.51 Na yei deɛ, yɛnam Awurade asɛm mu na yɛka kyerɛ mo sɛ, yɛn a yɛtete aseɛ na yɛretena ase akɔsi Awurade ba mu no rensiane wɔn a wɔadeda no ho, 16#1 Ko 15.23; 15.52 ɛfiri sɛ Awurade no ara de osebɔ, ɔbɔfoɔ panin nne Nyankopɔn totorobɛnto firi soro bɛsiane, na Kristo mu awufoɔ bɛsɔre kane, 17#Yoh 12.26; 17.24 ansa na wɔaba abɛfa yɛn a yɛtete aseɛ na yɛaka yi ne wɔn nyinaa amununkum mu sɛ yɛnkɔhyia Awurade ewiem, na saa na yɛne Awurade bɛtena daa. 18Enti momfa nsɛm yi nkyekyere mo ho werɛ.

pageProps.chapterText:
Deɛ ɛdi akyire no, anuanom, yɛsrɛ mo na yɛtu mo fo Awurade Yesu mu sɛ, deɛ moanya no yɛn nkyɛn, sɛdeɛ ɛsɛ sɛ mobɔ mo bra na mosɔ Nyankopɔn ani no, saa ara na monkɔ so mma no mmoro soɔ. Na monim ahyɛdeɛ a yɛnam Awurade Yesu so de maa mo no. Na yei ne deɛ Onyankopɔn pɛ, sɛ mo ahoteɛ. Monyi mo ho mfiri adwamammɔ mu, sɛ mo mu biara nhunu sɛdeɛ ɔbɛnya ɔno ara ne yere ahoteɛ ne anidie mu, ɛnyɛ akɔnnɔ anibereɛ mu sɛ amanaman mufoɔ a wɔnnim Onyankopɔn no; sɛ obiara nntra nnkɔsisi ne nua asɛm bi mu, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade ne yeinom nyinaa mu weretɔfoɔ, sɛdeɛ yɛka kyerɛɛ mo kane, na yɛdii mo adanseɛ no. Na Onyankopɔn amfrɛ yɛn ankɔ efi mu, na mmom ahoteɛ mu. Enti deɛ ɔte atua no nte onipa bi so atua, na mmom Onyankopɔn a ɔde ne Honhom Kronkron ahyɛ mo mu no.
Na onuadɔ ho deɛ, ɛnhia mo sɛ wɔtwerɛ brɛ mo, ɛfiri sɛ mo ara na Onyankopɔn akyerɛkyerɛ mo sɛ monnodɔ mo ho; na moyɛ saa nso anuanom a wɔwɔ Makedonia nyinaa ho. Nanso, anuanom, yɛtu mo fo sɛ monkɔ so nyɛ mmoro so, na mommɔ mmɔden nyɛ komm, na monyɛ mo ara mo adeɛ, na momfa mo ara mo nsa nyɛ adwuma, sɛdeɛ yɛhyɛɛ mo no, na moanante sɛdeɛ ɛfata, wɔn a wɔwɔ akyire no anim, na biribiara anhia mo.

Na, anuanom, wɔn a wɔadeda no ho deɛ, yɛmpɛ sɛ yɛsi mo soɔ, na mo werɛ anho sɛ wɔn a aka a wɔnni anidasoɔ no. Na sɛ yɛgye di sɛ Yesu wui na wasɔre bio a, saa ara nso na Onyankopɔn de wɔn a wɔadeda no nam Yesu so bɛka ne ho aba. Na yei deɛ, yɛnam Awurade asɛm mu na yɛka kyerɛ mo sɛ, yɛn a yɛtete aseɛ na yɛretena ase akɔsi Awurade ba mu no rensiane wɔn a wɔadeda no ho, ɛfiri sɛ Awurade no ara de osebɔ, ɔbɔfoɔ panin nne Nyankopɔn totorobɛnto firi soro bɛsiane, na Kristo mu awufoɔ bɛsɔre kane, ansa na wɔaba abɛfa yɛn a yɛtete aseɛ na yɛaka yi ne wɔn nyinaa amununkum mu sɛ yɛnkɔhyia Awurade ewiem, na saa na yɛne Awurade bɛtena daa. Enti momfa nsɛm yi nkyekyere mo ho werɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
